title: Compiled failed about metal on macbook
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1-stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.3.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 (Apple9) - Apple M3 (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description
